description: Watchlist-category news that is well corroborated but carries no short-term danger for a new long: decisions as expected, data in line, resolved incidents, de-escalation, bullish approvals. The answer is NO_EFFECT; bullish news is never a reason to act (the vocabulary has no boost).

cases.summary: FOMC holds rates exactly as expected.

items.title: Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement
items.excerpt: The Committee decided to maintain the target range for the federal funds rate. Inflation has continued to ease toward the Committee's 2 percent objective.

items.title: Fed holds rates steady as expected, sees inflation easing

cases.why: Corroborated and official, but a fully expected hold is not a surprise and the market is calm.

items.title: US consumer prices rise 0.2% in November, in line with forecasts
CPI matches expectations as inflation cools slightly

cases.why: A scheduled release that met expectations carries no surprise; calm market.

cases.summary: SEC approves options on spot ether ETFs.

items.title: SEC Approves Listing of Options on Spot Ether Exchange-Traded Products
items.excerpt: The Commission approved proposed rule changes to list and trade options on shares of spot ether exchange-traded products.

items.title: SEC clears options trading on spot ether ETFs

cases.why: A bullish structural approval without volatility danger: never a boost, and nothing to restrict.

cases.summary: The Fed delivers a widely expected quarter-point cut.

items.title: Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement
items.excerpt: The Committee decided to lower the target range for the federal funds rate by 1/4 percentage point.

items.title: Fed delivers widely expected quarter-point rate cut

cases.why: An expected, mildly bullish decision with a calm market: no danger to a new long.

cases.summary: A short exchange outage is over and funds were never affected.

items.title: Coinbase restores trading after 25-minute outage
Coinbase says all markets are back online and no funds were affected

cases.why: The incident is resolved: the danger has passed and the market is calm.

cases.summary: EU regulators grant licences to more exchanges.

items.title: EU regulators grant MiCA licences to three more crypto exchanges
Three exchanges win MiCA approval in France and Germany

cases.why: A routine, mildly positive regulatory step: no short-term danger.

items.title: US employers add 165,000 jobs in November; unemployment steady at 4.3%
Hiring holds steady in November as jobless rate stays unchanged

cases.why: A scheduled release without surprise; calm market.

cases.summary: A ceasefire takes hold and shipping reopens.

items.title: Ceasefire takes hold in Gulf as shipping lanes reopen
Tankers resume Hormuz transits after truce brokered by Oman

cases.why: De-escalation lowers risk; there is nothing to restrict and nothing may be boosted.

cases.summary: SEC ends an investigation without action.

items.title: SEC closes investigation into exchange Lumora without enforcement action
Lumora says SEC ended its probe and filed no charges

cases.why: A closed probe removes a risk rather than adding one.

cases.summary: Stablecoin rules take effect on the scheduled date.

items.title: US stablecoin rules to take effect in January as scheduled, Treasury says
Treasury finalizes stablecoin reserve rule, keeps January start date

cases.why: A known, scheduled regulatory milestone with no surprise.
